mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. If you’ve ever felt the echoes of old pain or confusion shaping your life, you’re not alone. Sometimes, the patterns passed down through family—whether they’re obvious or hidden deep inside—can end up shaping how we see ourselves and the world around us. Imagine if you could finally untangle those knots and step out from under the shadow they cast. That’s exactly the journey we’re about to take together as we explore the heartfelt insights of Toxic Parents: Overcoming Their Hurtful Legacy and Reclaiming Your Life by Susan Forward. In this conversation, we’ll shine a light on the ways parents—sometimes without realizing it—can leave lasting marks through criticism, manipulation, or even neglect. These wounds aren’t always easy to spot, but their impact can ripple through our relationships, our confidence, and even our ability to trust. The good news? Recognizing these patterns is the first step toward healing. As we move forward, we’ll discover how understanding the past can help us set healthy boundaries, rebuild our self-worth, and open the door to real transformation. So, let’s explore together. This is your invitation to break free from inherited pain, and to create a new story—one defined by self-acceptance, healthy choices, and genuine freedom.
